title: Share of all US births conceived via IVF (%)

source.name: Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) Surveillance data
source.publisher: CDC / Society for Assisted Reproductive Technology (SART)

notes: 2022: 91,771 IVF births out of roughly 3.67 million total US births, about 2.5% (1 in 37), per CDC/ASRM reporting. 2013 baseline is an approximate reconstruction consistent with CDC's finding that ART cycles more than doubled between 2013 and 2022.
